_info: Animation Story Engine v1.0 — Output Schema. Claude: output hamesha isi structure mein do. Phase 1 = story_bible, Phase 2 = scenes (bina shots), Phase 3 = scenes with shots.

variety_seed.core_conflict: object that should not be moved

story_bible.logline: 1 line — kaun, kya chahta hai, kya rokta hai

characters.name: string
characters.voice: deep calm male / young energetic female ...
characters.consistency_tag: FULL visual description in English — age, body, face, skin tone, hair, outfit, accessories. Har prompt mein exactly same copy karna hai.

locations.location_tag: FULL visual description in English with fixed details (colors, key furniture positions). Har prompt mein same.

props_master.name: old mirror
props_master.description: an oval antique mirror with tarnished silver frame and a crack on top-left

visual_style_guide.negative_prompt: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, deformed face, blurry, low quality, gore

shots.action: simple Hindi/English description of what happens
shots.image_prompt: [style_prompt], wide shot, eye level, [C01 consistency_tag], standing at the gate holding a torch, [L01 location_tag], moonlight through fog, desaturated blue-green palette, eerie mood, 16:9
shots.video_prompt: camera slowly pushes in; fog drifts across the ground; character takes two hesitant steps forward; torch beam flickers
shots.continuity_note: torch in right hand; scarf on

continuity_checkpoint._info: Har batch ke start mein do
